*Mystical thorned vines appear at your bidding and bind your foes.*

| **Area, Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**  |               **Main action** |
|--------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube) within 10**  | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** 2 damage; A < WEAK, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 3 damage; A < AVERAGE, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **17+:** 7 damage; A < STRONG, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
